_about: James Durham (1622-1658) texts missing from lane A's durham_shelf.json, kept as a separate shelf so lane A's file is never edited. Lane A left The Dying Man's Testament (1659) pending because its OCR never names Durham; the 1680 second edition (EEBO scan) does, and the 1659 first edition is held with an identity note from its front matter. Durham's sermon collections, published posthumously, survive only in 17th- and 18th-century printings (EEBO and ECCO microfilm). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

_identity_checked.durham-dying-mans-testament-1659: The 1659 OCR prints the name as 'DVRHAM' (old type V for U). The title page, read by eye, names 'Mr. JAMES DVRHAM, late Minister of the Gospel in Glasgow', published by John Carstares with a preface by Robert Blair.
